MRI Information
The Vega Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 T or 3.0 T
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 12 T/m
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg ≤ 0.4 W/kg
Head SAR not specified ≤ 1 W/kg
Scan Regions Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 20 mm beyond the implant.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
